description: Record a sale and generate the bill of sale: who sold, who bought, what item (with VIN, serial or IMEI where it has one), the price in minor units and the date. Returns the BOS-YYYY-NNNN number of the draft. The draft can still be changed with sale_update; sale_finalize freezes it into the signing copy and sale_render prints it. Free tier: 10 drafts.

as_is.description: Include the as-is clause: sold with all faults, no warranties except any written here. Default true, the norm for second-hand sales; pass false to leave it out

buyer_address.description: The buyer's postal address, one string

buyer_name.description: Who is buying, e.g. Jane Kowalska or Northwind Sp. z o.o.

condition.description: The condition at handover, e.g. used, good working order, or new, sealed

currency.description: ISO code the price is in

date.description: The date of the sale, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

duplicate_ok.description: Record it even though an identical sale to the same buyer exists, for a genuinely repeated sale. Default false

identifier_other.description: Any other identifying number, e.g. a hull number or an asset tag

imei.description: IMEI, 15 digits, for a phone or tablet

item_category.description: What kind of item, e.g. vehicle, equipment, electronics, stock

item_description.description: What was sold, specific enough to identify it, e.g. 2019 Honda Civic 1.5 petrol, grey, or MacBook Pro 14-inch 2021

notes.description: Anything else the document should say, e.g. payment method or what is included in the sale

price_minor.description: The sale price in whole minor units (integer cents). 120000 is USD 1,200.00

quantity.description: How many units this document covers. Default 1

seller_address.description: The seller's postal address, one string

seller_name.description: Who is selling. Defaults to the shared business profile's name when the profile has one

serial.description: Serial number, for equipment and electronics

vin.description: Vehicle Identification Number, 17 characters, for a vehicle sale

warranty.description: A warranty the seller does give, in their own words, e.g. The seller warrants the engine for 30 days from the sale date

name: sale_create
title: Record a sale
